# Timer:stopCondition

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 26.1.0</span></div>

Get / Set the stop condition of the timer.

```lua
timer:stopCondition([condition])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `condition` | [Source](../../objects/Source/index.md) | optional | omit to read the current value |

## Returns

None or condition ([Source](../../objects/Source/index.md))

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
timer = model.getTimer(0)
timer:stopCondition(nil) -- will set the default stop condition
timer:stopCondition(CATEGORY_NONE) -- will set a custom stop condition
print(time:stopCondition())
```
